name: Gakuen Tantei Transparency
original_name: 学園探偵トランスパレンシー
source:
When ever I look, I'll see something I'm not suppose to... 

A love affair in the baseball club between two young player 
A married, flirtatious P.E. teacher 
A Ka*data type Magic User 
A male student with the ability to see through things 
And something's going on in the Judo Club

[From barachan]
translation:
每当我看过去，就会看到不该看到的东西……

棒球部两名年轻选手之间的恋情
已婚且爱调情的体育老师
一名Ka*data类型的魔法使用者
拥有透视能力的男学生
以及柔道部里正在发生的某件事

[来自barachan]
